mechanism_narrative: A higher federal funds rate compresses equity valuations by increasing the discount rate for future cash flows, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is above 5.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 4.0% signals an economic slowdown, prompting monetary policy easing and boosting equity valuations, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 4.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the labor market is strong (PAYEMS > 157000) and consumer spending is robust (RSAFS > 680000), the economy is in a sustainable expansion phase, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when both PAYEMS > 157000 and RSAFS > 680000, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a high inflation environment (CPIAUCSL > 5.0% YoY), the Federal Reserve is likely to maintain a restrictive monetary policy, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 5.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100 (index 2017=100), it indicates a manufacturing slowdown, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 100, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 1.6 million units signals strong consumer confidence and economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST > 1600.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates a strong labor market, which supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS is above the 50th percentile, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is high (FEDFUNDS > 5.0%) and unemployment is low (UNRATE < 4.0%), the economy is in a high-pressure environment that may lead to a recession, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 5.0% and UNRATE < 4.0%, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.
